info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Eligibility Inquiry API
info.description: The Product Eligibility Inquiry API enables organizations to verify customer eligibility for various financial products. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding which products a customer qualifies for based on their profile and account status. Financial institutions and customer service teams leverage this functionality to enhance customer interactions and streamline the onboarding process. By providing quick access to eligibility data, this API supports informed decision-making and improves the customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the eligibility details for products associated with customers. It fetches comprehensive information about which products are available for the specified customer based on predefined criteria.
